fidelity.reason: A generic JEDEC MS-012AA / IPC gullwing land pattern generated by kicad-footprint-generator (descr cites the Analog Devices R-8 package drawing), not TI CAD. Its pads, 1.95 x 0.6 mm at x = +/-2.475 mm, differ from TI's D0008A example land pattern, 1.55 x 0.6 mm with a 5.4 mm row span (pad centres +/-2.7 mm). Using a generic IPC/JEDEC pattern is a project choice (fact-tmp1075-footprint-choice).
